title: Setup and safe service checks

sources.supports: Virtual environments isolate interpreters/packages; sys.prefix differs from sys.base_prefix; activation is optional when using the interpreter path; POSIX and Windows commands.
StateGraph compilation, START/END edges and deterministic Python steps do not require a model.
US, EU, APAC and AWS US have distinct official SaaS API endpoints; dashboard hosts are not API hosts.
Default cloud endpoint is https://app.langwatch.ai; Settings API keys need LANGWATCH_PROJECT_ID; project scope, SDK setup and flush do not replace dashboard verification.
401 authentication, 403 permissions, 404 resource, 429 rate/cap limits, 529 overload, request IDs and bounded retry diagnostics.

limitations: P00 is added preparation, not a source-video chapter or original exercise.
No .env was accessed and no live API, telemetry or dashboard checks were performed for this module.
Readiness means local/syntactic readiness only; it does not establish credential validity, model access, network connectivity or trace ingestion.
P00 deliberately rejects --live and non-none tracing backends; the separate shared connection-check CLI requires explicit instructor authorization and reads local configuration.
Only listed official cloud origins are supported by the teaching validator; self-hosted/proxy endpoints require a separately reviewed policy.
The synthetic model ID claude-course-example demonstrates syntax only and is not a recommendation or claim of availability.
Windows instructions are supplied from official documentation but have not been executed on Windows.
